# CLI reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from src/linchpin/cli.py; do not edit by hand -->

`linchpin <global options> <command> ...` (or `python -m linchpin`). Every command prints JSON on stdout;
warnings and errors go to stderr. LINCHPIN only reads files: it sends no packets.

State: `ingest` and `scenario` write the findings to the state file (default `.linchpin/findings.json`, env
`LINCHPIN_STATE`); `scenario`, and `ingest` with a topology YAML that sets config keys, also store a
`config.json` next to it, which then overrides `--config`. Every analysis command rebuilds the attack graph
from the state deterministically.


## Global options

| option | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--version` | show program's version number and exit |
| `--state` `STATE` | findings state file (env LINCHPIN_STATE; default .linchpin/findings.json) |
| `--config` `CONFIG` | weights / entry points / crown jewels YAML (env LINCHPIN_CONFIG; default config.yaml) |

## Commands

| command | purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`ingest`](#ingest) | parse exports (nmap/OpenVAS/Nessus XML, SharpHound JSON, inventory YAML, native JSON) into the state file |
| [`scenario`](#scenario) | load a scenario YAML (exports + topology overlay + intel) as the state |
| [`synth`](#synth) | write a synthetic enterprise (findings JSON + ground truth) |
| [`intel-build`](#intel-build) | build the NVD / EPSS / KEV lookup cache from downloaded feeds |
| [`build`](#build) | build the attack graph and print its size |
| [`paths`](#paths) | k cheapest entry -> crown-jewel attack paths |
| [`fix`](#fix) | ordered remediation plan with rationale and evidence paths |
| [`cuts`](#cuts) | exact minimum remediation cut and single-node chokepoints |
| [`whatif`](#whatif) | path statistics with some nodes removed (nothing is persisted) |
| [`node`](#node) | one node with its inbound / outbound attack edges |
| [`export`](#export) | export the attack graph (Neo4j .cypher script or GraphML) |
| [`neo4j-push`](#neo4j-push) | mirror the attack graph into Neo4j (password from NEO4J_PASSWORD) |
| [`serve`](#serve) | run the API + web UI (localhost only by default; needs the [api] extra) |

### ingest

parse exports (nmap/OpenVAS/Nessus XML, SharpHound JSON, inventory YAML, native JSON) into the state file.

```text
usage: linchpin ingest [-h] [--replace] [--intel INTEL] paths [paths ...]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `paths` | files or directories (directories are scanned one level deep) |
| `--replace` | discard previously ingested findings |
| `--intel` `INTEL` | CVE intel cache from `intel-build`, to fill in CVSS / EPSS / KEV |

### scenario

load a scenario YAML (exports + topology overlay + intel) as the state.

```text
usage: linchpin scenario [-h] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--no-intel] path
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `path` | scenario YAML, e.g. scenarios/composite_lab.yaml |
| `--data-dir` `DATA_DIR` | base directory of the exports it lists (default: the YAML's folder) |
| `--no-intel` | skip NVD / EPSS / KEV enrichment |

### synth

write a synthetic enterprise (findings JSON + ground truth).

```text
usage: linchpin synth [-h] [--family {single,multi,none,ad,legacy}] [--hosts HOSTS] [--seed SEED]
                      [--out OUT]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--family` `FAMILY` | topology family; all but `legacy` plant real CVEs from the packaged NVD/EPSS/KEV pool (`legacy` uses placeholder CVE-2099-* ids) (default single) (choices: single, multi, none, ad, legacy) |
| `--hosts` `HOSTS` | number of hosts (default 20) |
| `--seed` `SEED` | random seed (default 0) |
| `--out` `OUT` | output file (default data/synth.json) |

### intel-build

build the NVD / EPSS / KEV lookup cache from downloaded feeds.

```text
usage: linchpin intel-build [-h] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--out OUT]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--data-dir` `DATA_DIR` | folder written by scripts/download_data.py (default ../../datasets/linchpin) |
| `--out` `OUT` | cache path (default <data-dir>/derived/cve_intel.csv.gz) |

### build

build the attack graph and print its size.

```text
usage: linchpin build [-h]
```

### paths

k cheapest entry -> crown-jewel attack paths.

```text
usage: linchpin paths [-h] [--k K] [--explain]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--k` `K` | number of paths (default 10) |
| `--explain` | plain-English hop list instead of JSON |

### fix

ordered remediation plan with rationale and evidence paths.

```text
usage: linchpin fix [-h] [--budget BUDGET]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--budget` `BUDGET` | maximum number of fixes (default 5) |

### cuts

exact minimum remediation cut and single-node chokepoints.

```text
usage: linchpin cuts [-h] [--weighted]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--weighted` | also the minimum-effort cut (config fix_cost) |

### whatif

path statistics with some nodes removed (nothing is persisted).

```text
usage: linchpin whatif [-h] --remove REMOVE [REMOVE ...]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--remove` `REMOVE` | node ids; bare names mean host:<name> |

### node

one node with its inbound / outbound attack edges.

```text
usage: linchpin node [-h] id
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | node id, e.g. host:jump-01 or cred:svc_backup |

### export

export the attack graph (Neo4j .cypher script or GraphML).

```text
usage: linchpin export [-h] [--format {cypher,graphml}] --out OUT [--graph-name GRAPH_NAME]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--format` `FORMAT` | default cypher (choices: cypher, graphml) |
| `--out` `OUT` | output file |
| `--graph-name` `GRAPH_NAME` | graph tag on every node (default default) |

### neo4j-push

mirror the attack graph into Neo4j (password from NEO4J_PASSWORD).

```text
usage: linchpin neo4j-push [-h] [--graph-name GRAPH_NAME]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--graph-name` `GRAPH_NAME` | graph tag on every node (default default) |

### serve

run the API + web UI (localhost only by default; needs the [api] extra).

```text
usage: linchpin serve [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--scenario SCENARIO] [--data-dir DATA_DIR]
```

| argument | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--host` `HOST` | bind address (default 127.0.0.1) |
| `--port` `PORT` | port (default 8000) |
| `--scenario` `SCENARIO` | scenario YAML to preload (else a synthetic demo) |
| `--data-dir` `DATA_DIR` | base directory for the scenario's exports |

## Configuration file

```yaml
weights: {w1: 0.5, w2: 0.3, w3: 0.2}
skill_penalty: {network_exploit: 0.1, cred_reuse: 0.2, client_side: 0.4, privesc: 0.3, acl_abuse: 0.25}
entrypoints: ["auto:internet_facing"]          # or host ids
crown_jewels: ["auto:sensitivity=high"]        # or node / host ids
k_shortest: 10
exploitability_source: intel                   # or: learned (M11 model score where present)
fix_cost: {Vuln: 1, Credential: 1, Ace: 1, Host: 3}   # effort weights for `cuts --weighted`
neo4j: {uri: "bolt://localhost:7687", user: neo4j}  # password only via NEO4J_PASSWORD
```

## Environment

| variable | used by | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LINCHPIN_STATE` | all | default for `--state` |
| `LINCHPIN_CONFIG` | all | default for `--config` |
| `NEO4J_PASSWORD` | `neo4j-push` | Neo4j password (never read from the config file) |
| `LINCHPIN_SCENARIO`, `LINCHPIN_DATA_DIR`, ... | `serve` | see [HTTP API](api.md#limits-and-environment) |
